body: emily.cli commit b45f7e2. Combines Emiree's Mandelbrot ASCII fractal (ported from emiree.go, reads live h/p or defaults 0.5/0.5), the squish/tower/gematria transform (ported from QUEENSALLYONLINEBOOKOFMAGIFICATIONANDUNICOR's pemdas.py), and a cheap Dallas-TX moon-phase read into a short legible tag. apples post and changelog add now auto-tag with the active session via currentSessionTag(). Session log: EMILY/var/sessions.ndjson.
title: emily session new|current — cheap/legible session fingerprint for Apple + changelog tagging
